package.name: rob_box_supervisor_msgs
package.description:
ROS 2 IDL for Avatar Supervisor (ADR-0028).
Provides typed services (AcquireFloor, ReleaseFloor, SetAvatarMode) and messages (TeleopHeartbeat, FloorState, AvatarStateMsg) so external clients (rob_box_quest, rob_box_telegram) talk to avatar_supervisor over a real wire contract instead of std_srvs/Trigger + JSON-in-data (transition tech debt that motivated this package — see ADR-0028 §4.2).
Implemented as ament_cmake + rosidl_default_generators because the parent package (rob_box_supervisor) is ament_python and cannot generate rosidl interfaces on its own.
